title: Node scenes
description: data/map/node-scenes.json (YOK-77): which scene runs each map node and what it is handed (opponent, Y4 tier, whether a win binds). Each setting is looked up from the most specific place to the least: the node's payload.scene, 'nodes', 'types', then the defaults. Type, node and yokai ids are open on purpose: a new node type, a per-node scene or a yokai getting its own kit is an edit to this file.

schema_version.description: Bumped when the meaning of a field changes; the loader rejects versions it does not know.

default_scene.description: Scene for a node whose type and id name none.

fallback_fighter.description: Kit that fights for a yokai with no 'fighter' under 'opponents' (logged when used).

tiers.description: Y4 rows: reaction delay in frames per tier.

types.description: Per node type (the map's 'type' ids). Each needs a tier.

rows.description: R8: per map row, per node type, what replaces the type's 'coins' on that row (the row-8 elder pays a rare ability instead of coins). 'nodes' still wins.

nodes.description: Per node id overrides; they win over 'types' and 'rows'.

opponents.description: Per yokai id: the kit that fights as it, and optionally its own tier and profile.

fighter.description: Fighter (kit) id in data/moves/. Leave out while the yokai has no kit: the fallback fights.

kit.description: How the opponent's kit is built. Left out = the fighter's own files in data/moves/. copy_of_ryo = Ryo's normals, throw and starters plus the special copied at the T1 lock (T0), on Ryo's model and clips; 'fighter' is then only the name profiles and the HUD use.

coins.description: R8: coins a won fight on the node pays. Default 0.

opponent.description: Stand-in yokai for a node that names none (merchant, dojo until their behaviour is built).

profile.description: Behaviour profile id for the opponent; without it the fighter's first profile plays.

binds.description: Winning binds the yokai: R3 heal, A7 draft and the binding card. Default false.
